source:
A strange boy who appears in the school from time to time.
His intangible body is wreathed in flames, giving him a ghostlike appearance.
Nobody knows for sure who—or what—he really is.

[From artbook]

[spoiler]He is given the name 'Shion' (シオン) by Sirei.[/spoiler]
